name: MathOlympiad-Bench
intro: MathOlympiad-Bench 是 Goedel-Prover-V2 引入的人工整理与核验 Lean 形式化奥林匹克数学基准。它汇集 Compfiles 与 IMOSLLean4 的现有形式化题目，通过人工补全陈述、合并跨文件依赖、拆分多定理记录并修复 Mathlib 兼容性，使每条记录恰含一个形式定理和对应非形式化陈述，再用 sorry 占位证明核验语句可编译。固定公开版本包含 360 题。评测在 Lean 4.9.0-rc1 下生成整段证明，失败时可利用编译器反馈连续修正两轮，并以 Pass@N（论文主要采用 Pass@32）汇总。
build_method: 人工整理与核验, Lean 编译验证
eval_feature: 形式化证明, Lean 验证器, 验证器引导自我修正
build_method_en: Human processing and verification, Lean compilation validation
eval_feature_en: Formal theorem proving, Lean verifier, verifier-guided self-correction
intro_en: MathOlympiad-Bench is the human-processed and human-verified Lean-formalized olympiad benchmark introduced by Goedel-Prover-V2. It collects existing formalizations from Compfiles and IMOSLLean4; humans complete statements, consolidate cross-file dependencies, split multi-theorem records, and repair Mathlib incompatibilities so that every record has exactly one formal theorem paired with its informal statement. Each statement is compilation-checked with a sorry proof placeholder. The pinned public release contains 360 problems. Evaluation generates whole proofs under Lean 4.9.0-rc1, may apply two sequential compiler-feedback correction rounds after failure, and reports Pass@N, with Pass@32 used in the main comparisons.

drawio_review_note: Primary-source review passed on 2026-07-21 against arXiv:2508.03613v1 Sections 3.1–3.2 and Appendix A, the official Goedel-LM/Goedel-Prover-V2 repository at commit 2e9036e118464aa96a8bebaf9f5b9d091aa3585c (https://github.com/Goedel-LM/Goedel-Prover-V2/tree/2e9036e118464aa96a8bebaf9f5b9d091aa3585c), and the Goedel-LM/MathOlympiadBench Hugging Face revision 1397f5ece2baea32fc65c0a156d7670fc9842f5b (https://huggingface.co/datasets/Goedel-LM/MathOlympiadBench/tree/1397f5ece2baea32fc65c0a156d7670fc9842f5b). MOBench.jsonl is byte-identical in the pinned code and dataset snapshots, has SHA-256 f286b8942a7b9517be103139d2240adaeabbc1e5f195eb2817aacf9109b1bb95, and contains exactly 360 test records: 158 IMO problems from 1959–2024, 131 IMO Shortlist problems from 2006–2023, 68 national-olympiad problems, and three mathematical puzzles. Every record exposes exactly one formal_statement, its informal_prefix, and a Lean source field; the release is public under Apache-2.0. The paper identifies Compfiles and IMOSLLean4 as upstream sources but does not disclose paper-time upstream commits. For reproducible source tracing, their heads observed on the audit date are pinned separately as Compfiles b8b70e3ac51a7603a4444d109117bc23d0125192 (https://github.com/dwrensha/compfiles/tree/b8b70e3ac51a7603a4444d109117bc23d0125192) and IMOSLLean4 fe287710a04126274fa804d8fc1bd5ffe52e7351 (https://github.com/mortarsanjaya/IMOSLLean4/tree/fe287710a04126274fa804d8fc1bd5ffe52e7351); these current trace pins are not claimed to be the authors' original extraction commits. Construction follows the paper's human processing of incomplete statements, cross-file dependencies, multiple theorems, and Mathlib incompatibilities; normalization to one formal theorem plus one corresponding informal statement; and compilation of every formal statement with a sorry placeholder. The MiniF2F comparison is an audit branch, not a release filter: the authors document at least three shared IMO cases where MiniF2F is weaker or mismatched and report no analogous issue in MathOlympiad-Bench. The paper evaluation uses Lean 4.9.0-rc1, a 30,000-token initial whole-proof limit, two sequential verifier-feedback correction rounds, a 40,000-token total output budget in self-correction mode, and Pass@N, with main results at N = 32. The pinned repository summarizer requires Lean's complete flag and rejects generated code containing apply? or exact?. Its README quick example uses max_new_tokens = 32,768 and its example pipeline sets max_model_len = 40,960; these are current public scaffold settings and do not replace the paper's documented 30,000/40,000 experimental budget. The repository pins its Mathlib fork submodule at 2f65ba7f1a9144b20c8e7358513548e317d26de1. Formal publication evidence [site-a11r-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 2745×945 (English) and 2733×945 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 2743×943 and 2731×943. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
